 Rochester, N.Y. (WHAM) — After a 13-year wait, Grand Theft Auto VI has finally arrived, and a Fairport man played a role in bringing the highly anticipated video game to life.
 Tim Powers, a veteran voice actor, voiced two characters in the game, calling it the biggest project of his career.
 "This game is unlike anything I've ever done before in my life," Powers said.
 Powers recorded his lines two years ago but had to keep his involvement a secret until the game's release.
 MORE: Experts have tips for parents to navigate hype around 'GTA VI' and its mature content 
 "It is the biggest thing I've ever been involved in," he said. "So many of my friends in the industry are in this. And we had to sit on this."
 Despite his years of experience, Powers said the project introduced him to new technology, including facial performance capture.
 "This time they actually put a harness on my head with a little camera and made me do some articulations with my face because they motion captured, they performance captured my face," he said.
 Now, Powers is looking forward to seeing players experience the game and hearing the work of his fellow voice actors.
 "Plenty of my friends are going to play this game, and I will absolutely be watching over their shoulder while we sit through 80 hours of gameplay just so I can hear my friends," he said.
